parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description: Enables or disables the DNS Relay function.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: The status of the DNS relay. {{enum}} The {{enum|Error}} value MAY be used by the CPE to indicate a locally defined error condition.

object.description: DNS Relay object. The DNS proxy (or relay) function allows the forwarding of local network DNS queries to local or external DNS server(s) {{bibref|RFC5625}}.
